thresholds.rationale: Absolute graph p95 is wall-clock on the host. A loaded runner measured 96-100 ms against a 38.8 ms laptop snapshot and failed a 2x ms band. The gate compares graph p95 to rag p95 in the same run. Both arms see the same scheduler. A 2x band on that ratio absorbs first-query warmup. It does not catch a compile-cache miss: a --no-compile-once run still sits inside the band. When compile_once is true, mean graph compile_ms must stay under 0.5. Cost is exactly 0 on ASK_MODEL=fake; any positive mean fails.
